calibration.text: ADE completo: multi-harness, paralelo, orquestación, revisión y remoto bien resueltos.
Muy completo; le falta una pieza o algo de madurez para ser el estándar.
Hace bien lo importante, con carencias claras en remoto, móvil o extensibilidad.
Workspace útil pero acotado: no cubre el ciclo completo de agentes.
Multiplexor o herramienta parcial; no es un ADE completo.

limits: Solo se puntúan ADEs investigados. El resto queda en la cola, sin nota inventada.
La puntuación es editorial y se basa en la web oficial, README, docs y releases; no es una prueba práctica de cada flujo.
Un ADE no es un agente ni un framework: es el workspace donde orquestas agentes de código.
Precios, licencias y funciones cambian; confirma en la web oficial antes de decidir.
La cola de investigación no es un ranking: son nombres pendientes de revisar uno por uno.
meta.ranking_rule: Orden: ADE Score (0-100) de mayor a menor. Solo ADEs investigados; la cola no tiene nota.

ready.release_note: v0.12.4 Released on October 31, 2026 TL;DR Stopping a command now lets it shut down cleanly. On macOS and Linux, Solo asks it to exit the way Ctrl+C would and escalates only if it keeps running. On Windows, Solo sends Ctrl+C and force-stops only after about 3 seconds. Child processes are stopped too, and a project whose folder is missing at startup is kept instead of removed. Timer and MCP messages to agents are much more dependable. They no longer get stuck unsubmitted in a prompt, never answer a permission prompt or question for you, and typing into an agent mid-delivery no longer locks its terminal. Resume also follows Claude Code's /clear and /resume , and Codex's -C . MCP gives you control over who can type into a process. Each process has an "Incoming MCP input" setting and keeps a log of the input it received, and agents can tell MCP input from your typing. spawn_agent also takes a working directory and a first prompt. A project's name now stays in sync with its solo.yml , and adding a git worktree of a project you already have links it to that project instead of creating a new one.
